chapter_title_en: The Fiendgod's War-Array and the Sword of Resolve
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 455: The Fiendgod's War-Array and Ji Ning's New Sword Stance
chapter_meta_description: In the aftermath of a savage battle, Ji Ning witnesses the indomitable spirit of ancient Fiendgods and experiences a profound breakthrough, giving birth to a new and powerful sword stance.
og_title: The Power of Pride: How Ancient Fiendgods Forged a New Sword Stance
og_description: A clash between nine hundred Fiendgods and nine Celestial Immortals triggers Ji Ning’s most profound Dao-heart enlightenment yet.
twitter_title: The Fiendgods go berserk, and Ji Ning unlocks a legendary new sword art.
twitter_description: A clash of pride and power! Witness the birth of the "I Shall Go" sword stance.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient combat formation used by Fiendgods to combine their divine power, creating a single, terrifyingly powerful phantom.
A classic Xianxia defensive formation based on the myth of the Eight Immortals; it creates a flowing, tidal barrier that excels at deflecting brute force attacks.
The elite, fearsome legion of the Xia Emperor, tasked with hunting down and slaughtering rogue Fiendgods.
The legendary sword-art of Immortal Beixing, characterized by an unrestrained, ruthless philosophy of slaying all that is unjust.
The tenth stance of the Three-Foot Sword, newly created by Ji Ning; it embodies an absolute, fearless resolve to face any obstacle in the pursuit of the Dao.
The internal dimensional space of a Ki Refining cultivator, acting as the core for storing power and treasures.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the Fiendgods so aggressive?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They have been imprisoned and tortured by the Shaoyin clan for countless ages. Their inborn pride and battle-fury demand vengeance over safety.
The Xia Emperor's personal anti-Fiendgod legion. Their arrival signals an absolute end to any Fiendgod rebellion.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Where did Ji Ning’s new sword stance come from?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a spontaneous, Dao-heart-driven epiphany triggered by witnessing the Fiendgods' fearless, suicidal assault.
